readme.text:
lantern

A small command-line tool that watches a folder and prints a line each time a file changes.

Usage
  lantern watch ./notes

Options
  --quiet   print only the file name
  --once    exit after the first change

This is a fictional sample written for the saved case files.

overview.purpose: Watches a folder and prints a line each time a file changes.
overview.audience: Developers who want a quick change log of a local folder.
quickStart: Run lantern watch ./notes in a terminal.
Edit a file in that folder and read the printed line.
